en.t: As for where she had run off to?

units.source_text: 我在那片杉树中找了个遍，但是竹叶上一点踩踏的痕迹也没有。

en.t: I searched all through that grove of cedars, but there was not the slightest trace of footprints on the bamboo leaves.

units.source_text: 仔细听了听，也只听见男子的断气声。

en.t: When I listened closely, all I could hear was the man breathing his last.
